heading: Reporting and disclosure requirements

tree.text: prescribe such regulations as may be necessary to address reporting and disclosure requirements for pension-linked emergency savings accounts; and

seek to prevent unnecessary reporting and disclosure for such accounts under this chapter, including for purposes of any reporting or disclosure related to pension plans required by this subchapter or under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The Internal Revenue Code of 1986, referred to in par. (2), is classified generally to Title 26, Internal Revenue Code.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section applicable to plan years beginning after Dec. 31, 2023, see section 127(g) of Pub. L. 117–328, set out as an Effective Date of 2022 Amendment note under section 72 of Title 26, Internal Revenue Code.
